definitions.explanation: A person skilled in formulating strategies, whether in business, politics, sports, or warfare. Carries a positive connotation of foresight and skill at planning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{戦略家|せんりゃくか}だ。
⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{監督|かんとく}→監督：00185_kantoku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{戦略家|せんりゃくか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られている→知る：00458_shiru⟧。
examples.english: That coach is known as a strategist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経営|けいえい}{陣|じん}→経営陣：20535_keieijin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{長期的|ちょうきてき}→長期的：20406_choukiteki⟧な⟦{視点|してん}→視点：03187_shiten⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}つ→持つ：00478_motsu⟧{戦略家|せんりゃくか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{欠|か}かせない→欠かす：10138_kakasu⟧。
examples.english: A management team can't do without a strategist who has a long-term perspective.

notes:
⟦{戦略|せんりゃく}→戦略：04869_senryaku⟧ (strategy) + ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ (person, specialist). The ⟦{家|か}→〜家：28339_ka⟧ suffix marks someone as an expert or practitioner in a field.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{優|すぐ}れた→優れる：02119_sugureru⟧{戦略家|せんりゃくか}: an outstanding strategist
- ⟦{天才|てんさい}→天才：09934_tensai⟧{戦略家|せんりゃくか}: a genius strategist
- {戦略家|せんりゃくか}⟦として→として：06802_toshite⟧⟦{知|し}られる→知る：00458_shiru⟧: to be known as a strategist
- ⟦{政治|せいじ}→政治：01629_seiji⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{戦略家|せんりゃくか}: a political strategist

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軍師|ぐんし}: military strategist — historical/literary; specifically a strategist advising a commander
- {策士|さくし}: schemer; tactician — can be negative, implying cunning
- {参謀|さんぼう}: staff officer; chief adviser — usually within a formal hierarchy
